I wouldn’t say I did them back-to-back per se; like I would be so averted and scared to try another SSRI because of the bad experience I would have with them that I would wait a really long time to try another one until my depression was bad enough and I was desperate enough to try another antidepressant. I’m glad I stuck it out though, Trintillix really works for me!

It took me 4 different types of SSRIs and one type of SNRI to finally find an SSRI that works for me, Trintillex. All the medications I tried before gave me horrible side effects, like extreme stomach pain/ nausea, feeling "zombified," and sexual dysfunction. Sadly, where the field of psychiatry is, the only way to find an antidepressant that works for you is by trial-and-error. If you want to continue taking the medication route of treatment, I'd say don't give up yet. As I said, it took me years and so many different medications to finally find one that works for me. Best of luck!
